name: Ori, Ochi, Onoe
source:
Yoshiyuki left everything behind to start a new life. Moving to the far away Shinrin City, everything is new. All is so calm, and so pure. Several years later however, the situation is very different. 

[From [url=http://renai.us/game/o3.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
义之抛下一切，开始了全新的生活。他搬到遥远的森林市，所有事物都如此新鲜，一切都那么宁静、纯粹。然而几年后，情况已经截然不同。

[摘自[url=http://renai.us/game/o3.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
